museum.onchain.title: 6529 Network Museum on Ethereum (preview)
museum.onchain.description: An unlinked test that reads the 6529 Network Museum from a ProvenanceRegistry contract on the Sepolia test network and shows each record only after its bytes match the chain.
museum.onchain.notice: Test preview. Every record on this page is read from a test registry on Sepolia, an Ethereum test network, and its bytes are fetched from IPFS by the content ID the chain stores. This is not the Museum's record on Ethereum mainnet.
museum.onchain.heading: The Museum, read from the chain
museum.onchain.intro: Each record below comes from the registry's state at a finalized block. Its text is fetched from IPFS by content ID and shown only when it hashes to the digest stored on-chain.

museum.onchain.unverified.heading: Records not verified
museum.onchain.stateDetail.verified: The bytes fetched by content ID hash to the digest stored on-chain{cid}.
museum.onchain.stateDetail.cid: , and their SHA-256 matches the content ID
museum.onchain.stateDetail.mismatch: The bytes served for this content ID do not match the digest stored on-chain. They are not shown.
museum.onchain.stateDetail.unavailable: No IPFS gateway served the bytes for this content ID. Only the on-chain facts are shown.
museum.onchain.stateDetail.unsupported: This page cannot check the record's hash algorithm or canonicalization. Its content is not shown.
museum.onchain.stateDetail.deleted: The registry owner deleted this version. Its hash and history remain on-chain; its content is not shown.
